# SPE Round 5 Plan: Invoice Extraction Agent

## Assumptions
- I assumed spec.md ends at R24, so the new rows below start at R25. The saved spec will use the next free ID.
- I assumed the 60-invoice set already has the scanned tag that R's round 4 Why relied on.
- I assumed each cell gets the same number of trials per invoice as in round 4.

## Where round 4 left us
- Q hit: it was predicted at 0.91 and measured 0.93. R missed: it was predicted at 0.95 and measured 0.88.
- For R, the naive guess (0.90) beat my prediction. R's Why assumed that OCR cleanup only helps. Nobody tested what the tool does to page layout. On two-column layouts it dropped line items (F9).
- The stop streak is 0 of 3 because round 4 had a miss.
- Field accuracy is not at a ceiling. The best config scored 0.93, so the ceiling rule does not apply.

## Specify

### Proposals from round 4
| ID | Decision | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | Adopt as new config S | This is the direct test of a fix for F9. S differs from R in one thing only. |
| P2 | Reject for r05. Log it as a default and open D-r05-1. | The AP lead has not supplied reference fields for 15 handwritten invoices. Claude must not write answer keys. Q at 0.93 is not near a ceiling. New tasks would also break the r04 to r05 comparison in the same round that tests the F9 fix. |
| P3 | Adopt | P trailed Q on every metric. Q becomes the reference config. Dropping P keeps the run at 3 configs, so the cost stays about the same as round 4. |

### Requirement table, round 5
| ID | Requirement | Source | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| R25 | Config S is R plus one change. S skips OCR cleanup when the layout detector finds two columns. | r04 F9, P1 | Detector gate (gate 3). `line_items_match` on the two-column subset. |
| R26 | No preprocessing tool may lower line-item recall on any layout subset below Q's recall, after allowing for the band. | r04 F9. r04 "Which Why broke" for R. | `line_items_match` on the two-column subset, S compared with Q. |
| R27 | Q is the reference config. Config P is retired. Rows that apply only to P stay in spec.md with the note "retired r05". | P3 | The config list in `r05-workflow.js` |
| R28 | Measure directly whether OCR cleanup improves scanned totals. This was R's claim, and it was never isolated. | r04 "Which Why broke" for R | `total_match` on the scanned subset, S minus Q |
| R29 | The grader gets a line-item check. Its selftest must show three things. A copy with one line item removed fails. A reordered copy passes. An empty output fails. | r04 F9 | Grader selftest (gate 1) |

The two-column subset is the list of invoices in F9's "Seen in" field. It is frozen before the run.

### Files after approval
- `spe/spec/transcripts/2026-10-21-r05.md` holds the pasted round 4 text and "go again", word for word.
- `spe/spec/spec.md` gets the round 5 table above. The "Proposed for round 5" table is marked resolved.
- `spe/spec/disagreements.md`:

| ID | Question | Option A | Option B | Work affected | Decides | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| D-r05-1 | Should we add 15 scanned handwritten invoices? | Add them in r06, scored as a separate subset | Do not add them | Task set, grader, cost | The user, with the AP lead for the references | Open. The r05 default is to not add them. |

- Commit: `spe(r05): specify`

## Predict

The configs differ by one change at each step:
- Q is the reference: Sonnet 5.5 with the schema-first prompt.
- R is Q plus the OCR cleanup tool. It is unchanged from r04.
- S is R plus the skip on two-column layouts.

| Metric | Q | R | S | Same as last round | Why | Grader check |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Field accuracy (all 60) | 0.93 ± 0.03 | 0.88 ± 0.03 | 0.93 ± 0.03 | Q 0.93, R 0.88, S 0.88 (taken from R) | Q and R did not change. S sends two-column layouts down Q's path. Round 4 showed no cleanup gain anywhere else. | `field_exact_match` (the r04 grader, unchanged) |
| Line-item recall, two-column subset | 0.95 ± 0.05 | 0.60 ± 0.15 | 0.95 ± 0.05 | Taken from the r04 regrade in gate 2 | F9 says cleanup drops these items. S skips cleanup on exactly these layouts. R's band is wide because the subset is small. | `line_items_match` (new) |
| Scanned-total accuracy, minus Q | 0 (reference) | 0.00 ± 0.05 | 0.00 ± 0.05 | Taken from the r04 regrade in gate 2 | Round 4 never measured a cleanup gain on scanned totals. Without evidence I predict no gain. | `total_match` on the scanned subset |

- A cell is a hit when the measured value falls inside its band.
- If S ties Q on scanned totals, then OCR cleanup adds nothing. I will propose dropping it in r06.
- The "same as last round" values for the two new metrics are filled in from the gate 2 regrade of r04 outputs. That regrade happens before any r05 trial runs. The prediction itself is saved before gate 2.

### After approval, before anything else
1. Copy this plan to `spe/plans/r05.md`.
2. Write `spe/predictions/r05.yaml`.
   - It starts with `# Saved before the eval ran. Do not edit after the run.`
   - It contains `round: 5`, `date: 2026-10-21`, and `author: Claude, approved by the user in plan mode`.
   - It lists configs Q, R, and S, each number with its band and Why, and `same_as_last_round`.
   - `spe/predictions/r05-draft.yaml` stays as it is.
3. Commit: `spe(r05): predict`

## Evaluate

### Build
- Add the two-column layout detector and the skip to the agent as config S. Agent code only. No changes to the grader or the references.
- Copy `spe/evals/harness/r04-workflow.js` to `spe/evals/harness/r05-workflow.js`.
  - Set `const ROUND = 5`.
  - Set the configs to `[Q, R, S]`.
  - Add the `line_items_match` check and the scanned-subset slice.
  - No round number is written by hand in any prompt text.

### Gates, in order. Any failure halts the round and I report it.
1. **Grader selftest.**
   - Oracle outputs must pass.
   - Empty outputs and wrong outputs must fail.
   - For the line-item check, a copy with one item removed must fail, and a reordered copy must pass.
2. **Control regrade of r04.**
   - Regrade the saved r04 outputs with the r05 grader.
   - Field accuracy must reproduce the r04 numbers (Q 0.93, R 0.88). If it does not, the grader has drifted, and I halt.
   - R's line-item recall must come out low on the F9 invoices. This confirms that the new check catches F9.
   - This regrade also fills the naive column for the two new metrics.
3. **Detector gate.**
   - The skip must fire on every F9 "Seen in" invoice.
   - It must not fire on the 5 lowest-numbered single-column invoices.
4. **Dry run on 3 cells.**
   - The cells are S on one F9 invoice, S on one scanned single-column invoice, and Q on one digital invoice.
   - This checks the schema, the transcript scan, and the cost per trial.
- Commit: `spe(r05): evaluate harness`. Then launch the Workflow.

### Workflow arguments
- `ROUND`: 5
- `configs`: Q, R, S. The model is pinned to Sonnet 5.5 for all three.
- `tasks`: the same 60 invoices as r04. Trials per cell are the same as r04.
- `extra_trials`: split cells get up to 2 extra trials each, with a total cap of 30 extra trials.
- `budget_cap`: 1.25 times the measured r04 spend. Trials that would cross the cap are skipped and logged.
- Trial outputs must match the extraction schema.
- Code checks run first. A judge is used only for fields that code cannot check, as in r04.
- Trials have no read access to `spe/`, the reference fields, the graders, or the predictions. After the run I scan the transcripts for those paths. Any trial that peeked is voided.
- The run ends with failure analysis and a completeness critic.

### Cost (unmeasured estimate)
- The run should cost about the same as round 4. It still has 3 configs and 60 invoices, because S replaces P.
- The gates add the dry run (3 cells) and a regrade that makes no model calls.

## Close-out, when the completion notice arrives
- `spe/prediction-log.md`:
  - Add one row per metric and config.
  - Add "Which Why broke" for every miss.
  - Say plainly if the naive guess won.
- `spe/failures.md`:
  - Set F9's Fix to "fixed in r05" or "not fixed", with the numbers as evidence.
  - Add F10 and later IDs for any new failure types.
- In spec.md, add a "Proposed for round 6" table that includes D-r05-1. Write `spe/predictions/r06-draft.yaml` with `status: draft`.
- Update `spe/README.md`.
- Commit `spe(r05): learn` and tag it `spe-r05`. I will not push.
- If every cell hits, the stop streak becomes 1 of 3.
